text:
paula_cs: Heads-up — Novalume Labs renewal is paused. Commercial signed but procurement refuses to attach PO until (1) invoice legal name matches PO, (2) billing cadence clarified (they requested move from annual to monthly billing), and (3) vendor code present. Quote/notes: https://docsend.com/s/novalume-renewal. Can we triage?

rick_ae: quick context: customer asked for monthly billing due to cashflow. Sales approved monthly billing with a small credit back for annual commitment. Need legal to confirm language for monthly installments.

sani_fin: finance note: switching to monthly changes how we invoice and recognize revenue. We'll need explicit payment schedule in SOW (month-by-month amounts and effective date). Also vendor code required to attach PO — no vendor code, no PO in AP.

proc_bot: Auto-check: vendor lookup for "Novalume Technologies Ltd" returned no exact match. Recommend temp vendor code TEMP-NVL-128 to allow PO attachment while finance processes permanent vendor.

karen_legal: i'll prepare a short amendment. Proposed text (paste verbatim): `Billing cadence: Customer elects monthly billing; invoices will be issued monthly in arrears. An annual commitment credit of 10% is applied as a monthly amortized credit over 12 months. Payment due within 30 days of invoice.`

maya_se: i'll update the SOW with Karen's wording and generate a DocuSign envelope. Who are the signers on the customer side?

paula_cs: procurement contact is marta.procure@novalume.co and CFO is neil@novalume.co. Ask them to include company reg number and confirm legal entity name they will reference on PO (they used "Novalume Technologies Ltd" in their request).

sani_fin: if they insist on using Novalume Technologies Ltd but our legal entity is Novalume Labs Inc, finance requires either (a) a trading-as line on the SOW that maps the PO name to our legal name, OR (b) they provide invoice-to legal entity documents. We prefer trading-as to speed things up.

karen_legal: drafting trading-as line: `Seller invoices will be issued to Novalume Labs Inc; Buyer may reference 'Novalume Technologies Ltd' on purchase orders. Such reference does not change Seller's legal obligations.` I'll add that to the amendment.

maya_se: DocuSign envelope created: https://docusign.com/envelope/nv-2026-monthly routed to Neil (CFO) then Marta (procurement). Included Karen's clause and a note with temp vendor code suggestion. Envelope expiry 7 days.

proc_bot: Reminder: include temp code TEMP-NVL-128 in envelope comments so procurement can attach PO immediately. Set vendor creation ticket to finance queue #VEND-993.

rick_ae: pinged customer to request reg number and confirm they'll accept the trading-as clause. Also asked if they can sign today for billing to start next month.

paula_cs: customer replied: they can sign but procurement refuses temp codes and insists on permanent vendor code before PO. they offered to upload reg docs if we can confirm how long vendor creation takes.

sani_fin: real time: vendor creation time varies but expedited flow can be 48–72 hours if reg docs + VAT provided. We can offer provisional processing if they provide reg doc and VAT now.

karen_legal: customer also asked about the amortized credit math. paste for SOW: `Monthly credit = (0.10 * annual_amount) / 12` — include example in the SOW table for clarity.

maya_se: added example. DocuSign shows Neil viewed envelope at 1865433300. No signature yet.

paula_cs: procurement uploaded reg doc and VAT at 1865433600 but wrote in notes that they need permanent vendor code before attachment — contradictory but they uploaded docs anyway.

proc_bot: Vendor creation triggered: finance ticket VEND-993 flagged for expedited processing. Suggested permanent vendor code ENT-NVL-554 upon verification.

sani_fin: verified reg doc and VAT at 1865433900. Creating permanent vendor ENT-NVL-554. ETA ~2 hours to fully provision in AP.

karen_legal: minor legal caveat: ensure the SOW includes a sentence on termination for non-payment under monthly terms. I'll append: `Failure to pay monthly invoices within 30 days may result in suspension of services until cure.`

maya_se: appended termination language and re-sent envelope notification. Added a short note for the customer showing the monthly schedule table and the sample credit line.

rick_ae: Neil opened envelope at 1865434500 and asked whether credit is refundable if they cancel mid-year. He wants to confirm the amortized credit stops on termination.

karen_legal: response: `Amortized annual credit ceases upon termination; any unapplied future credits are forfeited unless otherwise agreed in writing.` use that phrase.

paula_cs: pinging Neil directly to confirm signature. He said he'll sign after his AP team confirms vendor code.

sani_fin: permanent vendor ENT-NVL-554 provisioned at 1865435100. Finance confirmed vendor visible in AP.

maya_se: updated DocuSign envelope comments to list ENT-NVL-554 and noted invoice will show Novalume Labs Inc with trading-as remark. Resent to Neil.

marta.procure@novalume.co: (customer) Thanks — we've confirmed vendor ENT-NVL-554. Signing now.

maya_se: Neil signed at 1865435520; Marta countersigned at 1865435580. PO attached referencing ENT-NVL-554.

paula_cs: status: SOW amendment signed, permanent vendor created, PO attached, billing cadence changed to monthly with amortized credit applied. Finance to queue monthly invoices. Closing thread; will follow up for the first invoice issuance. :white_check_mark:

proc_bot: Closing note: ticket VEND-993 closed and vendor ENT-NVL-554 created.
